summary: Step-by-step for preparing a community.general PR: create the ansible_collections/community directory, clone the repo or a fork into general, add an upstream remote, branch, add tests, push and open a PR. The checkout can be used with any local Ansible version.
questions: Where exactly should I clone community.general so Ansible can load it?
How do I set up a fork of community.general with an upstream remote?
Can I test my community.general changes against Ansible devel?
Do I need to add tests to a community.general pull request?

answer_card.title: Set up a community.general checkout and PR
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
mkdir -p ~/dev/ansible/collections/ansible_collections/community
cd ~/dev/ansible/collections/ansible_collections/community
git clone git@github.com:ansible-collections/community.general.git general
cd general
git remote add upstream git@github.com:ansible-collections/community.general.git  # if you cloned a fork
```
Then create a branch, commit, **add tests**, push to your fork and open a PR. You can use this checkout with any local Ansible, including a `devel` checkout.
